Subject: Short-term backfill & review cadence for L3 SRE (risk mitigation)

Hi Laura, Evelyn —

Quick heads-up: Jason (L3 SRE in APAC) put in notice effective 2026-12-17. He’s a key coverage owner for a handful of low-latency routes we rely on for the Redwood Dedicated infra tests. Losing him in mid-December without mitigation creates a >72h oncall exposure during our busiest rollout window.

Proposal (short, tangible asks):
- Request a 12-week contractor backfill (3d/week) starting 2026-12-20 to cover oncall rotation and handoffs.
- Run an accelerated performance review / 1:1 triage for the two junior SREs to reassign high-risk playbooks.
- Request a hiring-freeze exception for the contractor headcount and a one-time ramp budget (estimate attached).

Why this is urgent:
- Two-month lead time to fully onboard a perm hire; Dec/Jan rollout risk is high.
- The playbook handoff requires shadowing; contractor helps buy the slack without committing to full FTE.

Attached: sre-coverage-plan-v1.xlsx (coverage matrix + budget).

Ask: Laura, can you approve the freeze exception for a contractor (12 weeks) and confirm cost owner? Karthik I’ve CC’d you for budget sign-off; happy to route to finance after your nod. Evelyn, can you coordinate the review cadence with the SRE leads?

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(Attachment: sre-coverage-plan-v1.xlsx)

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet. I agree we can’t accept the coverage gap in December. Approve the hiring-freeze exception for a contractor up to 12 weeks, contingent on:

- Budget owner confirmation (please route to Karthik for chargeback)
- Contractor starts no earlier than 2026-12-20 and shadowing happens for at least 5 business days before Jason’s last day

Evelyn — please start the accelerated review cadence (two 30-min shadow + triage sessions this week) and post the updated playbook into the Drive link Marcus shared.

Marcus — after Karthik confirms budget, please loop HR for contract sourcing. If you need an interim credit to start onboarding tasks earlier, flag here and I’ll escalate.

-L
